verified.method: ed_chain.py (code A: scipy.sparse Hamiltonian with ARPACK eigsh, true residual 2.4e-14; code B: matrix-free Lanczos with full reorthogonalisation, residual 8.1e-15), S^z = 0 space of 12,870 states, no spatial symmetry, numpy 2.5.4 and scipy 1.18.1 on an Apple M5 laptop, 2026-11-11; results in checks/heisenberg-chain-16-ed/results.txt
verified.note: Pauli total; E/N = -0.446393523 in S.S units (S.S total -7.14229636062). H = sum_i S_i.S_{i+1} on the periodic chain (16 bonds). The S^z = 0 space holds a member of every spin multiplet, so its lowest level is the ground state. The same script reproduces the exact row of Heisenberg/chain_20_P to 6e-14. No published exact energy is carried for this instance; carried to 13 decimals, the agreement of the three calculations.
